purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/handi-quilter-sweet-sixteen.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Not a machine page. The handiquilter.com Sweet Sixteen tag lists only parts and accessories (foot pedal, spool pin clamp, My Secret Drawer, HighLight, large foot pedal). No current maker product page for the machine itself was found.

documents.type: HQ Sweet Sixteen User Manual QM30277 Version 3.3 (PDF, 42 pages, maker document hosted by a library)
documents.note: Cover: 'Handi Quilter 16-inch sit-down longarm', '2021' copyright, 'Released January 2020 Version 2'. Quick Facts on page 6; warranty on page 36; table and accessories pages 13 and 35. Text layer, no OCR needed.

HQ Quilting Machine Limited Warranty, text dated 08/26/10. Not model-specific: it says 'HQ QUILTING MACHINE'. Page metadata modified 2026-02-13.

Wording: 'This archived Getting Started video was orginally produced for the first HQ Sweet Sixteen stationary machine. It is provided for new owners who may have purchased this machine on the secondary used-machine market.'
Moxie ST, $6,495.00, 18 in throat, 2,100 spm, built-in stitch regulation, InSight table 38 x 38 in, page modified 2026-10-01.

documents.type: dealer page (Rocky Mountain Sewing and Vacuum)
documents.note: Dealer copy, not a maker document. Says discontinued, points to the Moxie ST. Quoted only to record where dealer wording differs from the maker manual.

facts.value: Manual Quick Facts 'Throat Dimensions: 8.25" X 16" (245 mm X 610 mm)'. Cover: 'Handi Quilter 16-inch sit-down longarm'.
facts.note: The maker's wording is 'Throat Dimensions' and '16-inch'; it does not say needle to body or needle to arm. Per rule 11 a 16 in head sits in the mid-arm band (16 to 18 in); the maker itself calls it a 'sit-down longarm'. Use the maker's wording only and do not call it a long-arm or a mid-arm on our own authority.

site.label: Throat dimensions
site.juki: 8.25 x 16 in (245 x 610 mm); 'Handi Quilter 16-inch sit-down longarm' on the cover.
site.others: Matches our 16 in; the maker does not say needle to body.

facts.value: Manual Quick Facts: 8.25 in (245 mm), the first figure of '8.25" X 16"'.
facts.note: The manual does not label which figure is height; our spec reads 8.25 as height and 16 as width. Dealer copy says '16 inches of throat space and 8 inches of vertical space'.

site.label: Throat height
site.others: Dealer copy: 8 inches of vertical space.

facts.value: Manual Quick Facts 'Quilting Speed: Maximum: 1500 SPM'. Page 22: My Speed range 5 % to 100 %, '75 and 1500 stitches per minute'.
facts.note: Dealer page (Rocky Mountain Sewing) says up to 1,800 spm. The Capri post says 2,200 spm for the Capri, a different machine. Both manual versions (3.1 and 3.3) say 1500.

site.label: Maximum speed
site.others: Rocky Mountain Sewing copy: up to 1,800 stitches per minute.

facts.value: Manual: 'Hook System: Rotary, Horizontal axis'; 'Bobbin Type: M-class bobbin, Aluminum, Class M'; 'Bobbin Case: Type MF'.
facts.spec_value: M class, aluminum bobbin case, rotary vertical hook
facts.note: Our spec says 'rotary vertical hook'. The manual says 'Rotary, Horizontal axis'. The spec value is not supported by the maker manual; the editor should correct the bobbin row (the M class bobbin part matches). The Quick Facts table prints the labels and values in separate blocks; value order was read from page positions.

site.label: Hook and bobbin
site.juki: Rotary hook, horizontal axis; M-class aluminum bobbin; case type MF.
site.others: Our spec says rotary vertical hook.

facts.value: Manual: 'Hopping Foot Stroke/Lift: 5 mm'. Needle bar stroke 35.3 mm; take-up stroke 73 mm.
Manual: 'LED Power Consumption: 2.25W'. Dealer copy lists an LED light ring.

Manual: 'Motor Type: Brushless DC'; 'Needle Positioning: Up and down, tieoff stitch'; 'Electrical Power US/Canada: 105 - 120 VAC, 47-63Hz, 300W peak'; 'Rest of world: 100 - 250 VAC, 47-63Hz, 300W peak'.
facts.spec_value: Brushless DC with up/down tie-off stitch; 90 to 264 VAC, 300 W peak
facts.note: Brushless DC, tie-off and 300 W peak confirm. The voltage range in our spec (90 to 264 VAC) matches neither manual line: US and Canada is 105 to 120 VAC, rest of world 100 to 250 VAC. Ask the editor to correct it.

site.label: Motor and power
site.juki: Brushless DC; 300 W peak; 105 to 120 VAC (US and Canada), 100 to 250 VAC (rest of world).

facts.value: Manual page 26: 'TruStitch stitch regulation (optional accessory)'. Maker lift table page: built-in InSight stitch regulation, 'Only applies to True-Stitch compatible machines with firmware of 3.18 or higher.'
facts.spec_value: Not built in; optional TruStitch regulator or InSight table with built in regulation
facts.note: Dealer copy (Rocky Mountain Sewing) says 'Product comes with Standard Table, Table Overlay, and TruStitch included', which differs from the maker manual's 'optional accessory'. The maker's Capri comments say an InSight table upgrade applies only if the machine is 'Tru-Stitch ready'.

site.label: Stitch regulation
site.juki: TruStitch is an 'optional accessory'. InSight lift table adds built-in regulation for TruStitch-compatible machines on firmware 3.18 or higher.
site.others: One dealer says TruStitch is included in its package.

facts.value: Manual page 13: table 'has folding legs that are height-adjustable'; 'The table weighs nearly 50 pounds'. Page 35: optional 18 x 30 in table extensions; two give 'a full six feet in width'.
facts.note: The manual does not give the base table's own dimensions or height range. The 36 x 30 in and 26 to 42 in figures in our spec come from dealer copy; the manual's 18 x 30 in extension is consistent with a 30 in deep table. Table weight 'nearly 50 pounds' is the table alone, not the machine.

site.label: Table
site.juki: Height-adjustable folding legs; table weighs nearly 50 lb; 18 x 30 in extensions sold separately.

facts.value: Manual Quick Facts and set-up pages give no machine head weight or dimensions. Lift table packaging: 66.14 lb, 38 x 28 x 8.5 in (accessory only).
facts.note: The maker publishes no head weight. Do not fill the spec from the lift table packaging figure.

facts.value: Warranty page: '90-day Limited Warranty', '10-year Limited Manufacturer's Warranty' on the sewing head casting or machining, '5-year* Mechanical Warranty' (parts), '5-year* electronic/electrical warranty' (parts). Footnote: 'All machines bought prior to 11-1-14 are subject to a 2-year mechanical and electrical warranty.' Registration card must be received 'before warranty is valid'. Labor and shipping are the customer's cost after 90 days.
facts.spec_value: 10 yr casting, 5 yr electrical, 5 yr mechanical (Handi Quilter longarm warranty)
facts.note: Not model-specific: the text covers 'the HQ QUILTING MACHINE'. The manual (page 36) carries the same 90 day, 5, 5, 10 structure. The page also states the electrical warranty is invalid if the machine is left plugged in when not in use (manual wording; web page omits it).

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: 90 days parts and labor; 10 years sewing head casting; 5 years mechanical parts; 5 years electrical parts. Registration required. Not model-specific.

facts.value: Maker support article: 'This archived Getting Started video was orginally produced for the first HQ Sweet Sixteen stationary machine. It is provided for new owners who may have purchased this machine on the secondary used-machine market.' handiquilter.com carries no Sweet Sixteen product page, only a tag archive of parts. Maker reply on the Capri post names the Moxie ST and Amara ST as the stationary machines it offers.
facts.note: The maker never uses the word 'discontinued' for the Sweet Sixteen in the pages read. The 'discontinued' statement comes from a dealer page. Record only the maker's own wording above.

site.label: Status
site.juki: No machine page; parts tag archive only; support article says the machine is on the 'secondary used-machine market'.
site.others: Dealer page: 'this item has been discontinued'.

facts.value: No maker MSRP for the Sweet Sixteen is published (no product page). Maker accessory prices: Lift Table for Sweet Sixteen $2,645.00; foot pedal $164.00. Sibling Moxie ST $6,495.00 on handiquilter.com.
facts.note: Dealer pricing only for the machine; our $6,495 last-seen figure is a dealer listing, not a maker price. Note it equals the Moxie ST MSRP, a coincidence to check before the editor treats it as an MSRP.

site.label: Price
site.juki: No maker price for the machine. Lift table accessory $2,645.00.

facts.value: Cover: 'DESIGNED BY A QUILTER, FOR QUILTERS.' Quick Facts: 'high-tech electronics and an innovative touch-pad user interface to offer greater functionality and ease of operation to home quilters than ever before conceived in the quilting industry' and 'a high quality machine that incorporates very robust design features and is very easy to service'. Manual page 6: 'This machine is intended for household use.'
facts.note: Marketing wording: quote as claims only. 'Longarm' appears in the maker's cover line as 'sit-down longarm'; that is the maker's term, not a throat-based class.

site.label: Maker claims
site.juki: 'greater functionality and ease of operation ... than ever before conceived in the quilting industry'; 'very robust design features'. Intended for household use.
site.others: Dealer: 'The most technologically advanced sit down free motion quilter'.
